note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (KrF-Sp-V centrist minority government under Kjell Magne Bondevik), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: strong trade unions linked to Labour, organised employers, influential rural and fishing interests, a free press, a state Lutheran church, and a conscript-based NATO military under civilian control.
